content: Leaderboard submission models (training knowledge; JS-rendered live pages unfetchable): PR-based self-report (SQuAD original, Papers with Code community submissions) — low cost, full audit history, human review, risk of unverifiable claims; automated evaluation server (GLUE/SuperGLUE eval server with registration + terms + single-model rule + code verification, EvalAI, CodaLab, Dynabench, HF Open LLM Leaderboard) — hidden test labels, standardized scoring, high infra cost; hybrid — PR to register + CI job runs verification before merge. Static-site leaderboards without backends are constrained to PR-based or hybrid-with-light-CI patterns.
